articles.summary: AI adoption is advancing across Indian banks. But are the foundations ready to support it at scale? Drawing on Zeta's Crossing the AI Divide report, this article examines the gap between AI deployment and institutional readiness, and what banks must strengthen across governance, engineering, systems, and skills to scale responsibly. Read the article to explore what it takes to move from successful deployments to repeatable AI adoption.
articles.title: AI in Indian Banking: Building Readiness to Match Ambition
